description.zh:
是否启用。取值：

- true（默认值）：启用。
- false：禁用。
description.en:
Specifies whether the product version is active. Valid values:

- true: The product version is active. This is the default value.

- false: The product version is inactive.

description.zh:
产品版本描述。

长度为1~128个字符。
description.en:
The description of the product version.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
推荐信息。取值：

- Default（默认值）：无。
- Recommended：稳定版。
- Latest：最新版。
- Deprecated：将废弃。
description.en:
The recommendation information. Valid values:

- Default: No recommendation information is provided. This is the default value.

- Recommended: the recommendation version.

- Latest: the latest version.

- Deprecated: the version that is about to be discontinued.
The ID of the product to which the product version belongs.

description.zh:
产品版本名称。

长度为1~128个字符。
description.en:
The name of the product version.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
产品模板类型。取值：

- RosTerraformTemplate：表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）支持的Terraform模板。
- RosStandardTemplate：表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）标准模板。
description.en:
The type of the product template. Valid values:

- RosTerraformTemplate: the Terraform template that is supported by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS).

- RosStandardTemplate: the standard ROS template.

description.zh:
模板的URL地址。

获取模板URL地址的方法，请参见[CreateTemplate](~~CreateTemplate~~)。
description.en:
The URL of the template.

For more information about how to obtain the URL of a template, see [CreateTemplate](~~CreateTemplate~~).

descriptions.zh: 调用该接口前，请先调用[CreateTemplate](~~CreateTemplate~~)创建模板。
descriptions.en: Before you call the CreateProductVersion operation, you must call the [CreateTemplate](~~CreateTemplate~~) operation to create a template.
